## Web Page to Knowledge Base

Template for ingesting a web page into your RAG knowledge base.

Suggested flow:
1. Set the target URL.
2. HTTP Request node fetches the page.
3. HTML Extract node pulls the readable text.
4. Split the text into chunks.
5. POST each chunk to the embeddings service (http://embeddings:80/embed).
6. Upsert the vectors into Qdrant (http://qdrant:6333).

Requires the embeddings and qdrant services enabled.
